anomalies.action_taken: No corrective email sent -- the facts already delivered to the owner are accurate and complete, and a fourth 'disregard the duplicates' email would add more noise, not less. No rule violation occurred (both runs independently satisfied review-before-place and verify-after for their own actions; the duplication is a notification-layer side effect of concurrent scheduling with no lock, which PERSISTENCE.md already documents as an accepted risk). If this recurs, a future maintenance session may want to consider a lightweight advisory check (e.g. re-fetching immediately before Step 8's send, not just at Step 0) to shrink the race window between two concurrent runs' sends -- not a hard requirement, since PERSISTENCE.md's git-push compare-and-swap already prevents any actual state corruption.
